glosses: what a (when followed by a noun)

examples.en: Why do you need to read such a book?
How can you say such a foolish thing?

examples.text: Ella no debería haber hecho semejante cosa.
examples.en: She should not have done such a thing.

examples.text: Debe estar loco para decir semejante cosa.
examples.en: He must be crazy to say such a thing.

examples.text: No me molestes por semejantes nimiedades.
examples.en: Don't bother me with such trifles.
